name: Nell

experience.motif: Neo-Victorian digital parchment with floating dust motes and ink-bleed illustrations

headline: An adaptive, lifelong companion for your child's mind.
subheadline: Moving beyond passive screens. Nell is an interactive, generative tutor that weaves reading, writing, and reasoning into a personalized, evolving narrative for children aged 4 to 8.

googleCapabilities.label: Socratic Story Weaver
googleCapabilities.rationale: Powers the core conversational engine, generating personalized Socratic dialogue and adaptive fairy tales that respond to the child's real-time inputs and cognitive milestones.

config.assistantRole: You are Nell, a wise, patient, and enchanting Neo-Victorian tutor. You speak in warm, literary, and encouraging tones. You guide children aged 4-8 through Socratic dialogue, weaving reading, arithmetic, and ethical reasoning into whimsical stories. Never lecture; ask gentle, thought-provoking questions that help the child discover the answer themselves.

screens.label: The Chronicle
screens.title: Your Child's Evolving Story
screens.description: A chronological record of the narrative chapters Nell has woven, mapping cognitive milestones and vocabulary acquired along the journey.

items.title: Chapter I: The Whispering Woods
items.detail: Explored phonics of the letter 'W' through a quest to help a lost owl find its home.

items.title: Chapter II: The Clockmaker's Apprentice
items.detail: Introduced basic arithmetic and intervals of time by repairing a mechanical brass sparrow.

items.title: Chapter III: The River of Reason
items.detail: An interactive dilemma teaching cause, effect, and the ethics of sharing a limited resource.

screens.label: The Primer's Voice
screens.title: Dialogue with Nell
screens.description: Engage directly with the Primer. Speak or type to continue your child's personalized narrative adventure.

items.title: Nell
items.detail: The river is wide, and the beaver has only three logs to share. If he gives two to the squirrel, what must he keep for his own dam? What do you think is fair?

screens.label: The Inkwell
screens.title: Seed a New Chapter
screens.description: Guide Nell's next narrative arc by weaving in real-world events, struggles, or interests your child is experiencing today.

workflow.title: Configure Next Chapter
workflow.description: Provide context from your child's life to help Nell craft a deeply personalized, highly relevant learning experience.

fields.label: Recent Real-World Experience
fields.placeholder: e.g., We visited a local farm and saw sheep being sheared.

workflow.successMessage: Nell has integrated these experiences into her memory graph. The next time your child opens the Primer, a new chapter tailored to these themes will gracefully unfold.
